statement: Chip stocks fell on July 16 2026 amid AI-spending jitters; Micron plunged almost 6% and TSMC declined despite record earnings.
why: Market skepticism about AI-capex sustainability could presage downward demand revisions.

impact.mechanism: Investor concern over AI spending signals possible pullback in AI-infrastructure demand.

evidence.excerpt: Chip stocks fell today as growing investor AI jitters and escalating violence between the U.S. and Iran further reduced risk appetite

confidence.basis: Single secondary source, one-day sentiment move.
